utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everybody. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-83-T, The Prosecutor versus Rasim Delic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could we have the appearances, please, starting with Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good afternoon, Your Honours, counsel, everyone in and around the courtroom. Aditya Menon and Daryl Mundis for the Prosecution, assisted by our case manager Alma Imamovic-Ivanov.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much and for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours, good afternoon to my colleagues from the Prosecution, to everyone in and around the courtroom. Vasvija Vidovic and Nicholas Robson representing General Rasim Delic, with our legal assist Lana Deljkic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President the Prosecution has for the reasons outlined in our motion filed on 11 January 2008, no witnesses to produce today. My understanding is that the Defence perhaps would be in a position to orally respond to that motion at today's sitting. I would ask that any discussion concerning the matters in our motion of 11 January 2008, as filed be dealt with in private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Mundis, it looks like we're unable to adjourn to a specific date.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That would seem to be the case, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. Well, then, the Court adjourns.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 3.38 p.m.,
